data.body: HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-11 21:54 PST: CLOSED through the completion-verifier gate at 21:53 PST. Gerrit 3359 merged as aed975de61c788b817028dd82051313c71139d3d at 21:29 PST. The plan took 9 review rounds, mostly over cross-engine reuse provenance and failure-class coverage. Final design: verdict_reuse is engine-matched; idempotent_reuse and drift_refresh stay engine-agnostic (same certification); failure classes come via RunnerAgentStep.last_error + plan_review_recovery.agentic_failure_error. The first close was refused because the landed commit touched src/rebar/llm/errors.py outside file_impact (the stop_reason class attribute). I declared it, re-reviewed (PASS), then closed. LLM-Review's 5 advisories are filed as mindless-misogynic-nematode (task, discovered_from this). Next in the epic: foliated-oceangoing-parrot (attestation engine field), whose plan was revised and is now under review.
